verdict.rationale: Pandoc exposes programmatic surfaces (a Haskell library, a CLI and an optional pandoc-server HTTP mode), so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair axis. The evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and a community report of the 3.0 packaging change breaking existing scripts shows no deprecation process, not one being documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
